## 3b.1 What ruff fixes {#extra-03b.1}

`ruff check --fix` fixes what it can, and lists the rest. It writes its fixes, and then exits with code 1, because
one problem is left.

```bash
uv run ruff check --fix
```

```bash
uv run ruff check --statistics
```

It fails, with exit code 1. It prints one line for the rule `SIM115`, open-file-with-context-handler, and then
`Found 1 error.` `main` opens a file and never closes it, and ruff cannot fix that.

Check your files against this move. The command prints nothing when they match, and otherwise shows what differs:

```bash
git check 429a29223911
```

If you are stuck, this command puts the files of this move in place of yours. A file that you made yourself stays:

```bash
git restore --source 909df18d1c02 --staged -- :/ && git restore --source 429a29223911 --staged --worktree -- :/
```

## 3b.2 main closes its file {#extra-03b.2}

ruff cannot fix SIM115. A `with` block closes the file when the block ends.

Apply the patch to [`src/tally/__init__.py`](#extra-03b.2-src-tally-__init__.py-b5485b), from the top of the project:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/rahuldave/tally/commit/25f4f751628b8461806074ef35b6cd489e7c9ce8.diff | git apply --include=src/tally/__init__.py
```

In `main` of `src/tally/__init__.py`, the patch puts an `if` and a `with` block in place of the line
`text = open(args[0]).read() if args else sys.stdin.read()`.

```bash
uv run ruff check
```

It prints `All checks passed!`.

Check your files against this move. The command prints nothing when they match, and otherwise shows what differs:

```bash
git check 25f4f751628b
```

If you are stuck, this command puts the files of this move in place of yours. A file that you made yourself stays:

```bash
git restore --source 429a29223911 --staged -- :/ && git restore --source 25f4f751628b --staged --worktree -- :/
```

### What changed {#extra-03b.2-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="extra-03b.2-src-tally-__init__.py-b5485b"></a>`src/tally/__init__.py`: a `with` block, which closes the file. 5 lines added, 1 removed. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/tally/blob/25f4f751628b8461806074ef35b6cd489e7c9ce8/src/tally/__init__.py).
  - look at `with open(args[0]) as file:`

<details open><summary>The patch to <code>src/tally/__init__.py</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -21,7 +21,11 @@ def main() -> None:

     if args[:1] == ["--top"]:
         n, args = int(args[1]), args[2:]
-    text = open(args[0]).read() if args else sys.stdin.read()
+    if args:

+            text = file.read()
+    else:
```
